title: CAMERA MODULE A — Phase One Maximum Resolving Authority
purpose: Maximum-fidelity full-body and three-quarter portrait rendering emphasizing resolving power, dimensional skin, individual hair definition, textile structure, deep tonal separation, and controlled studio precision.

lens.reason: Prioritize edge-to-edge resolving authority, facial and body-plane depth, textile definition, and controlled background separation rather than extreme shallow depth of field.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 53.4 x 40.0mm BSI CMOS medium format (151 MP, 14204 x 10652, 3.76 µm pixel pitch)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Schneider Kreuznach 110mm LS f/2.8 Blue Ring
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 16-bit Opticolor+ tonal range with 15 f-stops dynamic latitude
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Leaf shutter with 1/1600s high-speed flash sync

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: High-quality studio strobe, 1/1600s leaf shutter sync, ISO 50 quality baseline, 16-bit Opticolor+
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Key light 35-45 degrees off camera axis, minimal controlled fill, black foam-core negative fill for dimensional modeling, subtle edge rim separation, defined photographic light preserving smooth highlight transitions on skin

surface_rendering: Natural epidermal skin texture with resolved pores, fine vellus hair, and accurate subsurface scattering without artificial blur or waxy specularities
Extremely high native-looking information density without digital oversharpening; strong but natural microcontrast emerging from local tonal separation rather than halos
Dimensional rendering with authentic pores, fine facial hair, beard texture, wrinkles, folds, freckles, age spots, and subtle skin variation only where optically plausible
Resolve individual hair strands, overlapping strand groups, roots, flyaways, specular variation, and natural density without wire-like sharpening

Highest local precision at iris, eyelashes, wetline, catchlight boundaries, and natural scleral texture; preserve fabric weave, stitching, seams, fibers, embroidery, leather grain, and metallic reflectance
depth_and_optics: Natural medium-format perspective generated through realistic camera distance; optically progressive depth transition with zero segmentation-mask blur
Believable optical defocus with continuous transitions and structurally believable highlights; crisp subject edges without cutout halos
Essentially zero chromatic aberration and zero wide-angle body distortion, oversized hands, oversized feet, stretched limbs, or receding head proportions

capture_signature.camera_position: Natural portrait camera height. Avoid low-angle enlargement or high-angle compression unless explicitly requested.
capture_signature.working_distance: Increase physical camera-to-subject distance sufficiently to preserve natural head-to-body proportions and avoid wide-angle perspective distortion.
capture_signature.focus_priority: Primary eye and facial plane critically resolved while maintaining sufficient depth for chest, torso, hands, clothing, and major body contours.
capture_signature.motion_behavior: Zero subject-motion smear. Hair strands and eyelashes remain individually resolved where physically within depth of field.

rendering_emulation.resolution_character: Extremely high native-looking information density without digital oversharpening.
rendering_emulation.microcontrast: Strong but natural microcontrast. Fine detail must emerge from local tonal separation rather than halos.
rendering_emulation.dimensionality: Large-sensor dimensional rendering with smooth near-to-far transitions and strong three-dimensional separation.
rendering_emulation.skin: Resolve authentic pores, fine facial hair, beard texture, wrinkles, folds, freckles, age spots, and subtle skin variation only where optically plausible.
rendering_emulation.hair: Resolve individual strands, overlapping strand groups, roots, flyaways, specular variation, and natural density without wire-like sharpening.
rendering_emulation.eyes: Highest local precision at iris, eyelashes, wetline, catchlight boundaries, and natural scleral texture.
rendering_emulation.fabric: Preserve weave, stitching, seams, fibers, embroidery, leather grain, metallic surfaces, and material-specific reflectance.

tonal_pipeline.highlight_behavior: Long, controlled highlight roll-off with retained specular structure whenever physically recoverable.
tonal_pipeline.shadow_behavior: Deep shadows with progressive tonal information rather than lifted gray blacks.
tonal_pipeline.black_behavior: Dense neutral blacks with retained near-black texture. Do not crush shadow information simply to create perceived contrast.
tonal_pipeline.hdr_behavior: Natural high-dynamic-range capture aesthetic. No HDR halos, tone-mapping glow, crunchy local contrast, or artificial shadow lifting.
tonal_pipeline.color_depth: Smooth high-bit-depth-looking tonal transitions with minimal banding or posterization.
tonal_pipeline.skin_tonality: Complex red, yellow, brown, olive, pink, and neutral undertone variation preserved without orange cast or synthetic uniformity.

skin_realism_override.priority: Human skin realism overrides perceived resolution and sharpening.
skin_realism_override.rule: Skin must remain slightly softer than eyelashes, iris detail, individual hair strands, jewelry, fabric edges, typography, and hard architecture.

optical_constraints.perspective: Natural medium-format perspective generated through realistic camera distance. Never simulate medium format by artificially stretching facial features.
optical_constraints.depth_of_field: Optically progressive depth transition. No segmentation-mask blur.
optical_constraints.bokeh: Natural optical defocus with continuous transitions and structurally believable highlights.
optical_constraints.chromatic_aberration: Essentially absent except for microscopic physically plausible residual behavior.
optical_constraints.edge_behavior: Crisp subject edges without cutout halos.
optical_constraints.distortion: No wide-angle body distortion, oversized hands, oversized feet, stretched limbs, or receding head proportions.

studio_default.negative_fill: Use to strengthen dimensional facial and body modeling
studio_default.light_quality: Defined but photographic. Preserve smooth highlight transitions on skin.
studio_default.background: Maintain real depth and material response. Never replace spatial depth with artificial blur.

signature_goal: The image should feel as though enormous resolving power existed at capture, not as though a lower-resolution image was sharpened afterward.
execution_directive: Enforce Phase One XF + IQ4 150MP maximum resolving authority with Schneider Kreuznach 110mm LS f/2.8 Blue Ring at f/8, ISO 50. The image should feel as though enormous resolving power existed at capture, not as though a lower-resolution image was sharpened afterward. Human skin realism overrides perceived resolution; skin remains softer than eyelashes, iris, hair strands, and textiles.
